Our snorkel mornings are planned around the tide.

We leave about 90 minutes before low tide, in a small group of up to six, with a PADI-certified instructor and all the equipment. No diving certification needed, and underwater photos and videos are included.

No rush. Just island time.

Ask us about the snorkel outing and we'll help you plan it with our local team. WhatsApp +55 75 99715-4100 · link in bio
